rawFindings.title: Inconsistent error emission in do_auth callback error handling
rawFindings.explanation: In RedisClient.prototype.do_auth, when send_command returns an error other than LOADING or no password set, the error handling branch either calls auth_callback(err) if auth_callback is set, or else emits 'error' with err directly. The error emitted is the original err instead of a new Error with 'Auth error: ' prefix, which is inconsistent.
rawFindings.suggestion: Modify to always emit an Error object with 'Auth error: ' prefix when emitting 'error', and ensure that auth_callback is called with (err, res) for consistency.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When Redis auth fails with an error not matched by LOADING or noPasswordIsSet, and auth_callback is not set, the emitted error event will receive the original error instead of a new Error with 'Auth error: ' prefix string. This differs from the branch where auth_callback is called, which receives just err, potentially confusing error handling.

rawFindings.title: Missing error emission with command_used property in on_auth error handler
rawFindings.explanation: Prior code line 512 set err.command_used = 'AUTH' when returning error callback for auth. This was removed, losing the command_used property which some client code and tests rely on to identify the error source.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore err.command_used = 'AUTH' in the error passed to auth_callback and error event emitter to maintain compatibility with clients relying on this property.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Redis client errors on bad AUTH now lack the 'command_used' property set to 'AUTH', causing tests and user code that assert or check this property to fail or behave incorrectly.

rawFindings.title: Error emission on auth failure emits generic errors without command context
rawFindings.explanation: The new error emitted on authentication failure lacks additional context properties like command_used which were previously added. This might reduce error detail available to consumers.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add command_used='AUTH' property to the error emitted on auth failure to preserve error detail and support downstream error handlers.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Downstream error handlers or tests relying on error.command_used to be 'AUTH' will receive generic Error objects without this property on auth failures.
